title: CAMEL: Cross-Architecture Masked Embedding Learning for Ultra-Lightweight Retinal Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.40954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent progress in deep learning has substantially advanced automated grading of ophthalmologic pathologies, supported by large annotated datasets and improved representation learning. However, a significant gap remains between state-of-the-art performance and clinical scalability. In particular, foundation models have reshaped image-based medical screening and diagnosis. These large-scale architectures trained on extensive datasets learn rich, generalizable feature representations that can be adapted to a wide range of downstream tasks. In ophthalmology, RETFound, one of the most relevant foundation models for retinal images, performs strongly across classification, segmentation, and risk prediction tasks. Despite their effectiveness, foundation models are often computationally prohibitive, hindering their deployment in real-world clinical environments where hardware constraints and latency are critical. translated_title: CAMEL：面向超轻量级视网膜基础模型的跨架构掩码嵌入学习
translated_abstract: 深度学习的最新进展在大规模标注数据集和不断改进的表示学习的支持下，显著推动了眼科病理自动分级技术的发展。然而，最先进的性能与临床可扩展性之间仍然存在显著差距。特别是，基础模型已经重塑了基于图像的医学筛查与诊断。这些在海量数据集上训练的大规模架构学习到了丰富且可泛化的特征表示，能够适应广泛的下游任务。在眼科学领域，RETFound 作为视网膜图像领域最相关的基础模型之一，在分类、分割和风险预测等任务中表现出色。尽管基础模型效果显著，但其计算开销往往过于庞大，阻碍了它们在硬件资源受限且对延迟要求严苛的真实临床环境中的部署。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了……
tldr: 提出 CAMEL 方法，通过跨架构掩码嵌入学习构建超轻量级视网膜基础模型，在保持 RETFound 等基础模型性能的同时大幅降低计算开销，从而解决基础模型难以在真实临床环境中部署的问题。
en_tdlr: CAMEL introduces cross-architecture masked embedding learning to build ultra-lightweight retinal foundation models, preserving the performance of models like RETFound while drastically reducing computational cost for real-world clinical deployment.
